body.name: EOTCDev API
body.description: Open calendar data for the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church: date conversion, fasting days, fasting periods, and feasts.
body.note: All Ethiopian years are Amete Mihret. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. No auth, no rate limit, no key.

endpoints.GET /v1/fasting/{date}: Is it a fasting day, and why. ?calendar=gregorian|ethiopian
endpoints.GET /v1/fasts/{year}: All fasting periods of an Ethiopian year.
endpoints.GET /v1/calendar/{year}/{month}: One Ethiopian month, day by day.
endpoints.POST /v1/calendar/convert/batch: Convert many dates at once. body: {dates:[], calendar?}

periods.description: From Hidar 15 to the eve of Gena, kept in expectation of the Nativity.
The strict single-day fast on the eve of the Nativity.
The strict single-day fast on the eve of Timket.
Three days recalling Jonah's preaching to Nineveh. Always Monday to Wednesday.
Fifty-five days: the eight-day ጾመ ሕርቃል, the Forty Days, and Holy Week (ሰሙነ ሕማማት).
From the Monday after Pentecost until Hamle 5, the feast of Peter and Paul.
Sixteen days for the Assumption of the Virgin Mary. Widely kept by the laity.

weeklyFast.rule: Every Wednesday and Friday, suspended during the fifty days from Fasika to Pentecost, and on the great feasts of the Lord (Gena, Timket).
